findings.detail: The filing schedule shows debt investments of 597.891 million against total investments of 3120.386 million, so the PRIVATE_CREDIT share is only 19.16% and the vehicle-type BDC strategy assignment is inconsistent with source composition.

rationale: The raw investment schedule localizes the mismatch: debt/private-credit investments total 597.891 million while total investments are 3120.386 million, matching the flagged 19.16% private-credit share. Equity investments dominate the portfolio at 2269.950 million plus controlled/affiliated equity of 252.545 million. A targeted raw-source search for 'business development company' returned zero hits, so the VEHICLE_TYPE_BDC-derived PRIVATE_CREDIT strategy is not source-supported for this filing. The flag is therefore a real classification/lookthrough error rather than a false alarm.
